name: Example Character
notes: Apprenticed to the village smith. Granny tells old stories of the Aos Sí — he listens, but does not believe. Keep a cold-iron horseshoe close: iron is said to bite the Fair Folk.
description: A blacksmith's apprentice in a small Celtic village. He believes in iron, honest work, and things that can be held in the hand — not in fairy stories. Then the fairy ring glowed blue.
personality: Practical, skeptical, stubbornly grounded. Loyal to his granny, quietly in love with Niamh, and too proud to admit when he is afraid.
